TRANSCRIBED INDEPENDENTLY OF THE WAVE'S REFERENCE RECORD, WHICH IS THIS SAME FILER'S OTHER 2014 FILING. `_itemized_records/40bd7997.json` is Graves's 10-14 report (4 contributions / 2 expenditures, both sides closing at 2,725.75). THIS is his 12-14 report and it is a different document with a different outcome; nothing was copied from that record, and the two were compared only after this one was read, as a check that they are not the same filing.

WHY BOTH SIDES ARE 'empty-schedule' AND NOT 'no-schedule-page' AND NOT 'withheld': the document HAS both schedule pages, headed and identified — p3 is SCHEDULE A ('ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED', foliated 2 of 3, Last Name 'Graves', Date of Report 12-4-14) and p4 is SCHEDULE B ('ITEMIZED EXPENDITURES MADE', 3 of 3, same header) — and each carries ZERO entries. All 17 ruled lines on each page are completely empty: no date, no name, no address, no amount anywhere in either grid. The only marks the filer made on those two pages are the header box (name and date) and a SLASHED ZERO on each of the four footer lines, proved by the crops above. That is a real absence of entries, which is a different fact from a page that was never filed and from a page this transcription could not read.

THE ARITHMETIC, STATED THOUGH NO ROWS ARE PUBLISHED: the p2 SUMMARY PAGE is written entirely in SLASHED ZEROS down Column A — line 1 (contributions this period) 0, line 2 (expenditures this period) 0, line 3 (balance at beginning) 0, line 4 0, line 5 0, line 6 0, line 7 (balance at close) 0 — while Column B carries 4656.61 for contributions year-to-date and 4656.61 for expenditures year-to-date. Each schedule's own printed subtotal and total are likewise 0. So every printed figure agrees: nothing was received and nothing was spent in the 30-days-after-general window, and the campaign closed at zero having raised and spent 4,656.61 across the cycle. The Column B figures are CUMULATIVE and are never summed as increments in this per-period regime; note in particular that the two of them are EQUAL, which is what a fully-spent-out campaign looks like and is not a transcription artefact.

A NIL-NOTATION OBSERVATION WORTH RECORDING: this filer uses ONE nil mark consistently — a slashed zero — in all eleven places a figure could go (seven summary cells and four schedule footers). That is unusually consistent for this corpus; Addendum B5 records a filer using three different nil notations inside a single cycle, and 3de0387e earlier in this chunk voids its grids with full-height column strokes and writes plain oval zeros on the footers. Read per line all the same, which is what the crops did.

FOLIATION: the cover is UNNUMBERED and the three following sheets are numbered 1, 2 and 3 'of 3' — the 'excluding the cover' practice, the same as 3de0387e (Buhman) in this chunk and the opposite of fa00ee08 (Hemingway), who hand-numbers his cover '1/4'. Page ordinals locate nothing; every page here was classified from its own printed header.

PRIVACY: this file is not a *_Redacted.pdf and the county published it in the clear, but no donor or vendor data exists on it at all (both schedules are empty), so nothing was carried.
